findings.evidence: New join expectedCnt adjustment uses `rowsToMeetFirst := max(0.0, (outerRowCount-estimatedRowCount)*orderRatio)` in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go:585-597`. `tidb_opt_ordering_index_selectivity_ratio` allows negative values (min -1) in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go:3132-3135`, and is documented as “Value < 0 disables this enhancement” in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go:1641-1647`. For InnerJoin, `p.StatsInfo().RowCount` can exceed the outer child rowcount (not capped) per `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_join.go:545-563`, making `(outerRowCount-estimatedRowCount)` negative; multiplied by a negative `orderRatio`, the product becomes positive and the `max()` then applies a penalty even though the feature is disabled.
findings.fix: Guard the penalty by sign and direction, e.g. compute `rowsToMeetFirst := 0` unless `orderRatio > 0 && outerRowCount > estimatedRowCount`, or change to `rowsToMeetFirst := max(0.0, outerRowCount-estimatedRowCount) * max(0.0, orderRatio)` (then add it to the scaled expectedCnt).
findings.impact: Session-level disable (`< 0`) may still change IndexJoin cost/plan selection for ORDER BY/LIMIT joins where join output is estimated to expand rows (estimatedRowCount > outerRowCount), breaking the documented “disable” behavior and potentially causing plan instability/perf regressions when users try to turn the feature off.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed up to `upstream/master` (3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd): the same pattern exists in `upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go:270-283` (`rowsToMeetFirst = max(0.0, (outerRowCount-estimatedRowCount)*orderRatio)` inside `calcOuterExpectedCnt`).
findings.verify: Add a planner test with an ORDER BY + LIMIT IndexJoin where join cardinality expands (e.g., inner side duplicates join keys so `estimatedRowCount > outerRowCount`), then compare `EXPLAIN format=verbose` plan cost (or chosen plan) with `tidb_opt_ordering_index_selectivity_ratio = -1` vs baseline; disabled should match baseline and not introduce extra penalty. Also test `orderRatio > 0` only increases cost when `outerRowCount > estimatedRowCount` (join filters outer), not when it expands rows.
findings.what: `tidb_opt_ordering_index_selectivity_ratio < 0` (documented as disable) can still add a positive ordering penalty to IndexJoin outer ExpectedCnt when `estimatedRowCount > outerRowCount`, due to multiplying before `max()` (`max(0, (outer-estimated)*orderRatio)`) causing a sign flip.

subject: planner: extend order ratio to joins (#61687)
summary: Found 1 High issue in the new IndexJoin ExpectedCnt adjustment: negative `tidb_opt_ordering_index_selectivity_ratio` (documented as disable) can still apply a positive penalty when join cardinality expands rows, due to a sign-flip in `max(0, (outer-estimated)*orderRatio)`. This behavior persists on `upstream/master`.
